fluff.overview:
The Jupiter was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the waning years of the Civil War era, intended to serve as a cost-effective complement to the Turkina assault OmniMech. Khan Pryde directed the Falcon's Scientist and Technician Castes to design a new second-line assault 'Mech that could form the backbone of garrison Clusters, with a mandate for resource efficiency and rapid deployment. The design emerged from CJF Factory Zone 4 on Erewhon with suspicious speed, fueling rumors that the Scientist Caste had been developing the 'Mech covertly before revealing it to the warrior caste in late 3067.

Production began in 3068, with Jupiters appearing in large quantities along the Periphery border almost immediately. Built entirely from locally available components, the Jupiter proved a rugged and easily maintained assault platform, qualities that would later see it spread beyond Jade Falcon forces into mercenary and House armies throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere.
fluff.capabilities:
The Jupiter is a 100-ton assault 'Mech designed around a long-range fire paradigm that allows its pilots to engage targets well before closing to direct combat range. The heart of this philosophy is a weapon suite combining two Type XX Extended Range PPCs with four Type DL Ultra-5 autocannons, providing a devastating volume of fire at extended distances. Two Series IV LRM-15 launchers add indirect fire capability and sustained pressure on advancing enemies. The "spike collar" Goshawk E-Series sensor suite, which can be raised or lowered depending on battlefield conditions, gives the Jupiter enhanced targeting data that makes the most of its ranged weaponry.

A Gorvachs 300 XL engine propels the massive design to a top speed of 54 km/h, trading speed for the ability to carry nineteen and a half tons of Raydient Series 5 armor, protection rivaled by few other designs in its weight class. The reliance on an extralight engine does create vulnerability to flanking attacks, but the Jupiter's arsenal ensures that few opponents survive long enough to exploit this weakness at range.

The design's deliberate emphasis on locally sourced, commonly available components gives it a logistical advantage that many more complex assault 'Mechs cannot match, allowing field technicians to keep Jupiters operational with minimal supply chain dependencies.
fluff.history:
The Jupiter's development traces back to the eve of the Jihad, when Clan Jade Falcon sought to bolster its garrison forces with a capable assault 'Mech that could be produced without straining already-committed supply lines. CJF Factory Zone 4 on Erewhon was tasked with the design, and production commenced in 3068 with the 'Mech appearing along the Falcon's Periphery borders in significant numbers. The timing proved fortuitous, as second-line warriors defending Falcon worlds eagerly adopted the design.

The Jupiter's first major test came during the Hellion Tantrum of 3071–3072, when Clan Ice Hellion launched its ill-fated invasion of the Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. Before the assault, Jupiters had been concentrated among garrison Clusters, but the conflict demonstrated the design's combat effectiveness so convincingly that demand surged across all Falcon forces. Provisional Garrison Clusters equipped with Jupiters saw their firepower increase dramatically, delivering devastating defensive fire that helped break the Hellion advance.

Throughout the Jihad era, the Jupiter remained primarily a Jade Falcon weapon. The Clan successfully defended its exclusive possession through Trials of Possession, though reports from August 3073 placed Jupiters among Clan Hell's Horses forces during an attack on Thule, an acquisition the Falcons vigorously denied sanctioning. How the Horses obtained the assault design remains a matter of speculation among intelligence analysts.

The factory on Erewhon continued production through the early Dark Age, with newer variants entering service to keep the design relevant against evolving battlefield threats. In 3144, the factory was relocated from Erewhon to Alyina, though whether production continued uninterrupted at the new site remains uncertain. By the ilClan era, Clan Hell's Horses had assumed control of the facility, ensuring the Jupiter's continued service even as its original Falcon stewards saw their fortunes change dramatically.

The design's rugged construction and relatively simple logistics have also seen it spread beyond Clan forces, with mercenary commands and House armies acquiring examples through battlefield salvage and the post-Jihad arms trade. This proliferation stands as sign of the Falcon Scientist Caste's original mandate: build something tough, effective, and easy to keep running.
fluff.deployment: This variant sacrifices some of the base model's ranged firepower volume for increased close-range lethality and battlefield mobility. The four Ultra AC/5s are replaced with a pair of Ultra AC/10s, concentrating ballistic firepower into heavier-hitting weapons effective at shorter distances. The LRM-15 launchers receive Artemis IV fire control upgrades for improved accuracy, and the addition of jump jets granting ninety meters of jump capability gives this variant a degree of maneuverability unprecedented for a 100-ton assault platform. This combination makes it particularly effective in broken terrain where the standard model's pure long-range approach proves less viable.
